profile.title: School Profile
profile.subtitle: Get to know SMK Pertiwi Kuningan closer
profile.history_content: SMK Pertiwi Kuningan is the first Vocational High School in Kuningan Regency (established 1979) on an area of +/- 20,000 m2. It has graduated more than 11,000 alumni who work in industry/government, study at state/private universities, or become entrepreneurs. Current active students are 2,345 with an industrial curriculum and complete practical facilities including a swimming pool.
profile.vision_content: Realizing SMK Pertiwi Kuningan graduates who have noble character, are competent, high-achieving, and have an entrepreneurial spirit.
mission_list: To form graduates who are faithful and reject God Almighty.
Possess industrial and work-world standard hard skills and soft skills.
Prepare independent graduates and entrepreneurs through creative products.
advantages_list: One of the best schools in West Java

rpl.name: Software Engineering
rpl.desc: Focus on software engineering, web/mobile app architecture, basic DevOps, UI/UX, and agile collaboration.

tkj.name: Network & Computer Engineering
tkj.desc: Deepening design and implementation of wired/wireless networks, server virtualization, network security, and cloud computing.

tkr.name: Light Vehicle Engineering
tkr.desc: Learning diagnosis and maintenance of gasoline/EV light vehicles, EFI systems, and automatic transmissions.

tsm.name: Motorcycle Engineering
tsm.desc: Practice tune-up, overhaul, injection systems, electrical, and daily/competition motorcycle maintenance.

to.name: Autotronic
to.desc: Focus on modern automotive electronics: sensors/actuators, ECU, CAN bus, and active safety systems.

lp.name: Banking Services
lp.desc: Materials on customer service, banking products, basic accounting, cash management, and digital banking.

bdp.name: Online Business and Marketing
bdp.desc: Digital marketing strategy, copywriting, social media content, marketplace, and business analysis.

item_1.title: Nesman Soars! Futsal and Silat Achievement Gift for New Principal
item_1.summary: SMK Pertiwi Kuningan scores brilliant achievements in sports again. The Futsal and Pencak Silat teams successfully presented trophies as a warm welcome gift for the new Principal.

item_2.title: SMK Pertiwi Presents 'Simpai Sandekala Theater' at Cultural Carnival
item_2.summary: Enlivening the 527th Anniversary of Kuningan Regency, SMK Pertiwi Kuningan students amazed the audience with the theatrical performance 'Simpai Sandekala' on Jalan Siliwangi.

item_3.title: 'Free 30 Percent Students' Program for Educational Equity
item_3.summary: SMK Pertiwi Kuningan launched a massive scholarship program, waiving tuition fees for 30% of students as a form of social care.

item_4.title: First in Indonesia! Yamaha Motorcycle Racing Curriculum
item_4.summary: Exclusive collaboration with Yamaha Racing Indonesia, SMK Pertiwi Kuningan becomes the first school to implement a professional motorcycle racing standard curriculum.

item_5.title: 45th Anniversary 'Casperday' Enlivened by Armada Band
item_5.summary: The peak of the school's 'Casperday' anniversary celebration was a blast with a special performance from the Armada Band which entertained thousands of students and alumni.

item_6.title: Axioo Class Program Comparative Study Visit
item_6.summary: Becoming a national reference, SMK Pertiwi received a comparative study visit from 13 Vocational Schools throughout Indonesia regarding the implementation of the Axioo Class Program.

item_7.title: Yamaha Indonesia Support for School Racing Team
item_7.summary: PT. Yamaha Indonesia Motor Manufacturing (YIMM) handed over engine and chassis assistance for the research of the SMK Pertiwi Kuningan racing team.
